## Ctx.callbackDataPayload property

The first payload token parsed from callback data.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get callbackDataPayload(): string;
```

## Example


```typescript
// Data: "menu:settings:ok"
async callbackPayload() {
  console.log(this.callbackDataPayload) // "settings"
}
```
